name: v4b: all graphics in + your v4a notes
notes: First version with the graphics: 81 scenes (tongue, bacteria, throat, teeth, data, story, name and chapter cards). These are the FIRST-PASS graphics: the upgraded versions (real 3D renders, a new shot every 2-4 s, restaged people instead of cartoons, studio product renders, your real Zero Pro and AquaClean Duo photos, real papers, photos and archival footage) are still being built and replace these one by one. Some graphics may sit a few frames off their words because they were rendered before this re-cut; the next render fixes that automatically. Your v4a notes: the 2:01 wait is now just your sniff and grimace, then straight to 'Okay, so if it smells bad' (music drops out for the gag); screen glances trimmed at 107 cuts (never cutting a word). Where you glance during the last syllable, a split edit (picture cuts to your next line a few frames before the sound) comes in the next version. Music is now pinned to words, so it follows every re-cut. 13:10 total (was 13:27).
